response.draft:
Slide 1: Open When Our Neighbors Can Come
Fernwood Tool Library, Alder Falls
A proposal to the Alder Falls Community Fund
Request: $46,500 a year for two years ($93,000 in all)
Purpose: a part-time coordinator so we can open evenings and Saturdays
Sample organization. Fernwood Tool Library and all people named are fictional.

Slide 2: What Members Told Us
512 members answered our May 2026 survey
47% said our hours keep them from borrowing more
That was far ahead of the next answers: "the tool I wanted was out" (19%) and parking (11%)
Many work weekday afternoons and can't reach us before we close at 6 p.m.
"I've walked past at 6:15 more times than I can count. The lights are on and the door is locked."

Slide 3: Millbrook Is Missing Out the Most
Millbrook has 22% of Alder Falls renters
Only 9% of our members live there
61% of Millbrook members who answered named our hours as the barrier
Most of them work shifts
Our hours shut out the neighbors who could gain the most

Slide 4: The Limit Is the Door, Not the Tools
344 hold requests were waiting on June 30, 2026
Most were for the tile saw, the carpet cleaner and the pressure washer
Holds wait an average of 11 days
On the 3 days we're open, a returned tool often goes back out within the hour
On the 4 days we're closed, it sits on the shelf

Slide 5: What Members Get Today
1,962 active members, up from 1,410 a year earlier
9,840 tool loans in FY2026, up from 7,215
Sliding-scale membership from $0 to $60; about 1 member in 4 pays nothing
58% would otherwise have bought the tool new
Members estimate they saved a median of $180 each over the year
14 repair cafes: 438 of 611 items fixed
46 volunteers gave 3,120 hours

Slide 6: What Longer Hours Fix
Open 34 hours a week instead of 22
New: Tuesday and Thursday evenings until 8 p.m.
New: Saturday, 9 a.m. to 3 p.m.
Shift workers and 9-to-5 workers can finally reach us
Returned tools go back out sooner, so holds wait less

Slide 7: Why It Takes a Paid Coordinator
Today: 1 full-time director and 1 part-time shop lead
Volunteers can't cover every new shift
A trained lead must be on hand whenever power tools go out
A part-time coordinator at 25 hours a week makes the new hours safe and dependable

Slide 8: The Money
Cost: $46,500 a year more than FY2026, covering the coordinator plus utilities and supplies for longer hours
Request: $46,500 a year for two years = $93,000
FY2026 budget: $212,400, ended even with no debt
FY2027 budget for board review: $258,900
Each loan cost about $21.60 in FY2026
For comparison: a new tile saw costs about $400; a weekend store rental costs about $65

Slide 9: What We Expect, and How We'll Report
Staff estimate about 2,500 more loans a year once members learn the new times
This is our estimate, not a promise
We will report what actually happens
Thank you for considering Fernwood Tool Library
Rosa Delacroix-Imari, Director, Fernwood Tool Library (Sample)
